title: Reporting ACL Injuries
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess continuity on sagittal, coronal and axial images rather than on one plane.
State the bundle involvement wherever it can be seen.
Record the secondary signs of anterior translation separately from the ligament itself.
Report the menisci, the collateral structures and the cartilage from the same study.
Report the bone bruising pattern, which records the mechanism.
- The report should state the interval since injury or surgery.
